name: Cityscapes: Semantic Urban Scene Understanding Dataset
description: A premier benchmark dataset dedicated to semantic urban scene understanding for advanced driver assistance and autonomous driving systems. Contains diverse stereo video sequences recorded across 50 German and Swiss cities during different seasons and weather conditions. Features 5,000 finely annotated frames with pixel-level polygon labels across 30 visual classes spanning dynamic objects, road layouts, and background structures, plus 20,000 additional coarsely annotated frames for weakly supervised learning.
